title: Brandstadl Scheffau (KaiserWelt)
name: Brandstadl Scheffau (KaiserWelt)
kurzbeschreibung: The Brandstadl in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser: 1,650 m altitude, Brandstadlbahn, KaiserWelt play park in the magic forest, and dream panorama of the Wilder Kaiser.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Brandstadl rises to an altitude of 1,650 metres above the picturesque village of Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser in the Tyrolean Unterland. Accessible via the modern 4- and 8-seater Brandstadl gondola lift of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser – Brixental, the mountain is widely regarded as one of Western Austria's most diverse family and adventure mountains. Situated directly across from the mighty limestone walls of the Kaisergebirge, the summit plateau treats visitors to a breathtaking vista of the rugged Wilder Kaiser massif, the Hohe Salve, and the lush slopes of the Brixental.

KaiserWelt Scheffau & Adventure Trails

The centerpiece of the Brandstadl is the world-renowned KaiserWelt Scheffau: right by the mountain station, children and adults step through a towering castle gate into a mystical magic forest. Along winding pathways, visitors solve tricky riddles posed by the Emperor, explore multi-storey wooden treehouses, balance across suspension bridges, and conquer climbing walls. A generous water play area and the KaiserWald offer countless play stations harmoniously blending active outdoor play with an enthusiasm for nature. For hikers, the Brandstadl serves as an ideal hub: an easy panoramic trail leads over to the Filzalmsee in Hochsöll, while a sunny high trail heads to the Tanzbodenalm. Furthermore, the wheelchair-accessible Murmelrundweg fascinates guests with interactive stations dedicated to alpine wildlife.

Visit & Getting There

The Brandstadlbahn and KaiserWelt are open continuously every day from mid-May to late October between 09:00 and 17:00 during the summer season. Admission to the KaiserWelt is completely free with a valid cable car ticket (€0.00 additional entry fee). Summer lift fares (season 2025/2026): round trip adults approx. €31.50, youth approx. €23.50, children (born 2010–2018) approx. €16.00; small children ride free. Discounts are available with the Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer Card or the SkiWelt Erlebnis-Wanderpass. Public transport: ÖBB trains to Wörgl, Kufstein, or St. Johann in Tirol stations, where connecting Kaiserjet and regional buses run straight to the Scheffau valley station. By car: via the Inntalautobahn A12, exit Kufstein Süd or Wörgl Ost, taking the B178 Loferer Straße to Scheffau and parking at the large free cable car parking area.

Tips

The gondola lift and the KaiserWelt grounds surrounding the Brandstadl mountain restaurant are barrier-free; many woodland paths are covered with wood chips and can be navigated with all-terrain strollers. Stop by the Bergrestaurant Brandstadl to savor Tyrolean Gröstl or fresh Topfenstrudel on the expansive panoramic terrace.
